description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectSearchFilterParams class, which extends a filter parameters base class to encapsulate various filtering options for searching projects within the OrangeHRM Time module. The class manages properties such as project IDs, customer ID, employee number, names, and exclusion lists, providing getter and setter methods and setting a default sort field.

classes.name: ProjectSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that encapsulates filter parameters for project searches, including project IDs, customer ID, employee number, names, and exclusion lists, with default sorting set to project name.

methods.name: getProjectIds
methods.description: Returns the array of project IDs used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setProjectIds
methods.description: Sets the array of project IDs to filter the project search.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID to filter the project search.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name filter for projects.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name filter for projects.

methods.name: getCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Returns the customer or project name filter.

methods.name: setCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Sets the customer or project name filter.

methods.name: getExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Returns an array of project IDs to exclude from search results.

methods.name: setExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Sets the array of project IDs to exclude from search results.
